status: collection_only: read-only official road geometry snapshot for the NATIONAL Thailand envelope; no labels, snapping, model, thresholds or colours
version_note: v4.0 (2026-11-18, national-coverage branch): same sources (DOH/DRR/EXAT), hosts, predicate and code as v3.1; only the envelope is widened from the pilot frame to the whole-country broad bbox and the budget is raised to fit it. v3.1 config and all pilot outputs are protected (see protected_paths) and stay the accepted pilot evidence (git tag pilot-v3-20261118).

preregistration.registered_by: national-coverage plan (2026-11-18), before any national spatial model is fitted or evaluated
preregistration.note: national geometry-collection envelope = thailand_broad_bbox; a rectangle, so a few cross-border sections may be returned and are flagged, not dropped silently.

discovery_context.note: manager observations (national and pilot counts) are context only, never expected counts; the national EXAT count was not queried (null)

unit_audit.note: ratio of attribute value (scaled to metres) to the WGS84 geodesic length of the same full section; a single unit reaching min_share is only a hypothesis pending official documentation
